description: Every past run of one recurring series: when each task appeared, when it was ticked off, how long it lay there, and WHO closed it — the agent or a human. Required: recurrence_id. Optional: limit (default 20). Use it to see whether a series is actually being worked by the agent or quietly cleared by hand each time. Note: there is no start timestamp, so the reported minutes are how long the task lay open, not how long the work took.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_todo_history
